_note: No previous group result exists (single student, assigned dataset only). Baseline captured from the first documented from-scratch runs, then frozen. Official baseline = deduplicated data with the leaking column removed.

features.selection: all columns except target and Source IP
preprocessing: one-hot encode Highest Layer, Transport Layer, Dest IP (handle_unknown=ignore)

known_limitations: 89.9% of source rows are exact duplicates (766,840 of 852,585); on the full data a random split places identical rows in train and test.
Source IP is identical to the target (crosstab: 454,849 rows 0/0 and 397,736 rows 1/1, no mixed rows), so it is excluded as label leakage.

Even without Source IP, single features reach about 99.5% accuracy (Source Port 0.9946, Dest Port 0.9945, Packet Length 0.9963), so near-perfect scores are expected and the task is not discriminating between models.
